comment: In response to the request for public comments by the United States (U.S.) Environmental Protection Agency (EPA or Agency) regarding its proposed designation of vinyl chloride (CASRN 75-01-4) as a high priority substance under the Toxic Substances Control Act, the National Roofing Contractors Association (NRCA) expresses our support for comments developed by the Vinyl Institute (VI), summarized in the attached document, as well as comments filed by VI in the previous comment period.  Vinyl chloride is an essential commodity chemical that is a vital part of the value chain for many products, especially those in roofing materials and systems.
title: Comment submitted by National Roofing Contractors Association (NRCA)
